notes.title: Significant changes in land battles
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce the long waiting patch solving many issues in land battles. We rewrite a pathfinding system for land units and did many other changes improving land battles game-play.

You can see the changes in the video:
[previewyoutube=27O7_V4Pwts;full]https://youtu.be/27O7_V4Pwts[/previewyoutube]

[b]v1.1.1 rev.37783 patch notes:[/b]

1. Land units pathfinding overhaul. 
2. Fixed units stuck with obstacles.
3. Fixed the reported cases with split and teleport of a unit.
4. Improved column formation.
5. Distributed volley in case of an obstacle. Now units can not shoot through houses. Part of the unit that has the line of sight of an enemy can shot.
6. Improvement in input for land battles. Solved some conflict situations with input (i.e. failed to drag units group frontline on friendlies). 
7. Increased crew damage for ball-type shots.
8. Updated muskets for allied ships in late battles.
9. Broadside fire order now starts from the closest to the furthest cannon (related to target).
10. Updated Sea Wolfs reload skill (duration -> speed).
11. Updated Intelligence cutscene messages to inform the player that there is also a 3rd sub-mission with an enemy fleet arriving.
12. Fixed a possible case with the wrong battle outcome for the Nassau mission and updated Ai priorities accordingly.
13. Fixed a possible issue in Rice & Boats mission where frigate Scarborough could stuck on the bank of the river.
14. Fixed wrong nation for En cavalry battle.
15. Corrected/removed wrong unit names according to players' feedback.
16. Various minor improvements from forums and Discord feedback.  
17. Various text improvements according to players feedback.

notes.title: Release Candidate
notes.notes:
We are very happy to announce that Ultimate Admiral: Age of Sail is almost released. After a year in Early Access, our game is ready for new voyages in the high seas, seeking adventures, fame, and glory! With the support of our amazing community, we're proud to present a truly unique naval wargame experience with realistic naval combat and sailing physics, a detailed damage model, historical ship models, and weapons. Ultimate Admiral: Age of Sail offers the best of the Ultimate Series AI and tactical engine in naval, land, and combined arms landing operations. 

It has been a long road to release, full of hard working, completing the initially planned content, and solving technical issues. We didn't stick always with our initial plans during this EA. Our dynamically active community offered us valuable and encouraging feedback with numerous observations and requests. Many changes and new additions were made based on this live relation between our team and fans.   

One such major change was the rework of the AI Adaption system. Our initial attempt for challenging naval battles produced difficulty spikes in the campaign for some of the players. We applied a series of changes to Adaption to eliminate this issue and offer a smoother campaign progression. Additionally, to avoid some spotted confusion with player initial choices of the campaign options, the Adaptation mode became optional and the Classic one the default. Furthermore, a new option added before each naval battle, allowing players to change the difficulty for an easier or a harder one but better rewarded. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34954981/760eec92be44487017cacd5eb6842872ab27c8ea.png[/img]

On the other hand, a common positive comment we got, about the fan many players had using lower rate ships and frigates, led us to add in the Classic mode a limitation in the use of large Ships of the Line by the AI early in the campaign. This change resulted in an increase in the number of possible battles with frigates and smaller ships.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34954981/bce5725fbb2b517ba6dc94d07cbdecf94df7863f.png[/img]

Although we had initially decided not to make a saving system during the battle, our fans left us no other choice but to create one. Our talented programmers bypassed all technical limitations and added the option for unlimited saves during battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34954981/9e4de136f2a5fbfaa7891d650eb931ffa08ff009.png[/img]

The initial US campaign included some battles from the period of the Barbary Wars. Some comments that this part did not fit well with the rest of the US campaign, led to the creation of the Barbary Wars DLC. We replaced that part of the US campaign with the "European Voyage" chapter which takes place in the seas of the United Kingdom. We took the cut part and added 4x additional content creating the Barbary Wars DLC. The DLC was offered for free to all our fans who supported us during the EA!

It is really countless the list of changes we've did during the EA. There were improvements to naval AI for better and more intelligent ship maneuvers, a full rework of the soldier movement mechanics for smoother and more realistic animations and behavior, improved physical-based LOS, introduced real ballistics, improvements in UI and HUD and so many more, to ensure that the game has the level of quality and polish that our fans expect.

We would like to thank everyone who followed us on social media and supported our efforts from the first closed beta, the Backer build, the Early Access, and helped our team make this game better! 

The Ultimate Admiral: Age of Sail team

notes.title: Large "rebalance" patch
notes.notes:
v0.6.38 rev.34099 is released

Large "rebalance" patch affecting units, weapons, ship and difficulty system. We increased the transparency of characteristics by adding more tooltips. The patch must fix the most frequent reported crashes.

Patch notes:
1. Improved longboat pathfinding. You can feel that in the Snatch mission.
2. Experimental mode "match speed". Your ship will sync her speed with an assigned target. 
3. Added hint for units and improved hint for firearms.
4. Re-balance of land units
5. Re-balance of firearms
6. Re-balance of naval guns. Fixed reload time and weight.
7. Improvements in naval AI
8. Different fixes of crashes and issues in land battles.
9. You can send your boats directly to enemy ship in boarding. Not necessary to sail around of enemy hull.
10. Fixed graphical artifact in sea rendering.
11. Fixes and improves in UI.
12. Different improves in text
13. Tuned difficulty of the Bunker Hill battle.
14. Fixed crash in land battles being a source of the game's freeze or deployment of a ship in the battle.
15. Rebalance of ships' characteristics: turn rate, armor, and structure.
16. Rework of difficulty system based on your activities and reports.
17. Fixed issue when AI ships did not land troops
18. Added LOS button.
19. Added new quotes.
